name: Stevia

low.description: About 1 teaspoon powder or 5-10 drops liquid

siboNotes: Stevia is SIBO-friendly as it doesn't feed bacterial overgrowth and provides sweetness without digestive upset.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts as stevia is much sweeter than sugar
Look for pure stevia extract without added bulking agents like inulin or maltodextrin
Liquid stevia drops dissolve easily in beverages
Pure stevia powder works well in baking but may need recipe adjustments
nutritionalHighlights: Does not affect blood sugar levels
No artificial additives in pure forms
